nom: Paula's Choice Calm Redness Relief 1% Bha Lotion Exfoliant

avis.titre: Not for Dry, Rosacea skin --proceed with caution all others
avis.texte: All skin is different, so in this review, I will tell you about mine so you can better gauge how this might work/not work for you. I am in my early 40s with dry, sensitive skin (it may be rosacea). If that is you, PLEASE be warned: this product will HURT your skin; leave on acids are basically the devil if you meet this description. See Dr Dray on YouTube to learn about how Rosacea folks should not use BHA exfoliants (PHAs might be OK, depending). I guess the good news is: I found all this out in a memorable by using this product (even though I was super careful about testing it out). IF YOU HAVE OILY SKIN- this *might* be for you. Some additional caution...I read a lot of reviews where people jump right into using this every night for a week and why their skin is a disaster. Do yourself a favor and resist the "Go Big or Go Home" impulse. Patch test it and when you first really use it, wait 3-days and don't use it again during that time. Case in point: I patch tested (seemed to be OK) and then used it *once* at half dose (for lack of a better word). Day 1 my skin was amazing but Day 2...well, it took 3 weeks for it to recover.) If you have black heads/lots of oil, and do not have Rosacea, I think this is worth a shot for you. In all cases, those reading this review are trying to make their skin better and I sincerely hope you find what you are looking for.

avis.titre: I've only been using a week but I feel like the texture of my skin has improved
avis.texte: I've only been using a week but I feel like the texture of my skin has improved. I did notice a few more whiteheads on my cheek since beginning use but I'm not sure they're a result of the product (or if possibly they became more noticeable after the skin above them was exfoliated). So far so good. Oh! I have extremely sensitive skin and this doesn't burn or irritate at all.

Have only been using this new formula for 2 weeks and so far, so good! Can see a difference in the surface of my skin, in particular, my chin. Have not experienced any irritation. Much prefer the pump over the old pumpless bottle; one pump is just the right amount, so no waste. Plan to continue with this product!

The typical 2% salicylic acid products that are so widely available do a great job of clearing out and minimizing my pores, but because I have eczema and multiple skin and fragrance sensitivities, daily use of the 2% products also left me with patchy, red rashes all over my face. This is one of a very few products out there that uses a smaller percentage (1%) of salicylic acid, allowing me to use it on a daily basis to no ill effect. My skin has never looked better. So pleased I tried this before giving up on salicylic acid products altogether.

I have dry, sensitive, aging skin but still get cystic acne along my jaw line. It's pretty bad and I hate that I'm still dealing with it as an adult (I'm 37). I have been using this in the morning and Paula's choice 8% AHA in the evening , and Peter Thomas Ruth's Pumpkin Enzyme mask twice a week and with these three products my skin has never looked so good! My acne is almost completely cleared up, the redness in my cheeks is greatly diminished, my skin looks soft, supple and glowing, and my wrinkles have all but disappeared! This is a holy grail product for me!
It did minimize my pores but has not help the redness on my face.

avis.titre: Huge improvement in appearance of skin
avis.texte: I purchased this product for my husband. He has large pores and redness and rosacea. He has been using this product for a couple of months now. There has been a very noticeable improvement in his skin. His pores are much smaller and the inflammation and redness are greatly reduced. This was a great find and I will be ordering again.
Okay product, very gentle. Good if you have very sensitive skin with occasional breakouts. Keeps my skin clear, but it’s not really worth the price.
